source: Uganda National Road Network Repository / 5.Road Condition Data / 2025-26 / ROMDAS Data (raw ROMDAS Access-database exports, one file per surveyed link/lane run)
method: ROMDAS profilometer + rut-bar vehicle survey (Dynatest-class laser profiler); IRI sampled per 100m sub-section, rutting per 1m sub-section, network-average per file computed from all non-zero samples
note: Every ROMDAS survey file in the 2025-26 folder is included except 2 unreadable process-log-only files with no measurement tables (360_280825.mdb, 433_LINK02.mdb, both excluded). Road name/region/class/surface joined from the network register where the link code matches; unmatched codes are mostly DUCAR/feeder-road survey runs not in the national trunk register and are shown with the code only.
